components.s_zone: 0.5 * min(previous-visited-fine-cell-center distance km / 20, 1) + 0.5 * (1 - min(train-reference vessel count / 3, 1)); missing/zero density -> sparse score 1; fine density uses 0.01 degree grid with coarse 0.05 degree fallback
components.s_change: only after >=24 prior rows; mean of available robust length z squash, straightness z squash, and state surprise; z uses IQR/1.349, then std, then 1; squash=1-exp(-abs(z)/2)
components.s_gap: after first row; 0.5 * training empirical CDF of gap hours + 0.5 * training empirical CDF of jump metres
components.composite: nanmean of available components; all missing -> NaN; otherwise clip to [1e-6, 1.0]
components.direction: higher is more anomalous; exploratory score, not accident probability
